def test_withdraw_insufficient_funds(lg):
    """REQ: R7
    Withdrawal larger than balance raises InsufficientFunds."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 101)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


def test_withdraw_from_empty_account(lg):
    """REQ: R7
    Withdrawing anything from zero balance fails."""
    make(lg, "a1")
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0


def test_withdraw_exact_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R7
    Withdrawing exactly the full balance is allowed."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 100)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R8

def test_transfer_moves_money_and_ids(lg):
    """REQ: R8
    Transfers move money and return sequential ids T1, T2, ..."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 300, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 700
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 300
    assert lg.transfer("b1", "a1", 100, "k2") == "T2"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 800
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 200
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 800, "k3") == "T3"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 1000


def test_failed_transfers_do_not_consume_ids(lg):
    """REQ: R8, R11
    Only successful transfers advance the id counter."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 101, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 0, "k2")
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 50, "k3") == "T1"
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 50, "k4") == "T2"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -5, 1.0, "10"])
def test_transfer_invalid_amount(lg, amount):
    """REQ: R8, R4
    Transfer with invalid amount raises InvalidAmount and changes nothing."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", amount, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 0


def test_failed_transfer_key_can_be_reused(lg):
    """REQ: R8, R11, R12
    A failed transfer does not register its idempotency key."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 500, "k1")
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 40, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 60
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 40


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R9

def test_transfer_currency_mismatch(lg):
    """REQ: R9
    Different currencies raise CurrencyMismatch; nothing moves."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "e1", "EUR", 500)
    with pytest.raises(CurrencyMismatch):
        lg.transfer("a1", "e1", 100, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(CurrencyMismatch):
        lg.transfer("e1", "a1", 100, "k2")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1000
    assert lg.balance("e1") == 500
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 1000, None)]
    assert lg.history("e1") == [("deposit", 500, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R10

def test_transfer_same_account(lg):
    """REQ: R10
    Self-transfer raises ValueError and changes nothing."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.transfer("a1", "a1", 100, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1000
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 1000, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R11

def test_transfer_insufficient_funds(lg):
    """REQ: R11
    Transfer larger than source balance fails; neither balance changes."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD", 50)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 101, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 50
    assert lg.history("b1") == [("deposit", 50, None)]


def test_transfer_exact_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R11
    Transferring exactly the source balance is allowed."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 100, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 100


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R12

def test_idempotent_repeat(lg):
    """REQ: R12
    Repeating with same key and params returns original id and moves no money."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    t = lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 300, "k1")
    assert t == "T1"
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 300, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 300, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 700
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 300
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 1000, None), ("transfer_out", 300, "b1")]
    assert lg.history("b1") == [("transfer_in", 300, "a1")]
    # next new transfer gets T2
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 1, "k2") == "T2"


def test_idempotent_repeat_after_balance_drained(lg):
    """REQ: R12
    Replaying a key returns original id even if a fresh transfer would now fail."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 300)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 300, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 300, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 300


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R13

def test_idempotency_conflict(lg):
    """REQ: R13
    Reusing a key with different src, dst or amount raises IdempotencyConflict."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    make(lg, "c1", "USD", 1000)
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 100, "k1") == "T1"
    with pytest.raises(IdempotencyConflict):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 200, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(IdempotencyConflict):
        lg.transfer("a1", "c1", 100, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(IdempotencyConflict):
        lg.transfer("c1", "b1", 100, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(IdempotencyConflict):
        lg.transfer("b1", "a1", 100, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 900
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 100
    assert lg.balance("c1") == 1000
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 100, "k2") == "T2"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R14

def test_withdraw_limit_exact_and_exceeded(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Reaching the limit exactly is allowed; exceeding raises LimitExceeded."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 3_000_000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 2_000_000
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 2_000_000
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 3_000_000, None), ("withdrawal", LIMIT, None)]


def test_single_withdraw_over_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    A single withdrawal above the limit fails."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 3_000_000)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT + 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 3_000_000
    lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 2_000_000


def test_limit_combines_withdrawals_and_transfers(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Withdrawals and outgoing transfers share the daily limit."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 3_000_000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    lg.withdraw("a1", 600_000)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 400_001, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 2_400_000
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 0
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 400_000, "k2") == "T1"
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 1, "k3")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 2_000_000
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 400_000


def test_limit_failed_operation_does_not_consume_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    A rejected operation does not count toward the limit."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 3_000_000)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 1_500_000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 2_000_000


def test_limit_insufficient_funds_does_not_consume_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R14, R7
    A withdrawal failing for funds does not use limit."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 500)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 900_000)
    lg.deposit("a1", 2_000_000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1_000_500


def test_limit_incoming_and_deposits_do_not_count(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Incoming transfers and deposits do not count against the recipient's limit."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 3_000_000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD", 3_000_000)
    lg.transfer("a1", "b1", LIMIT, "k1")
    lg.deposit("b1", 5_000_000)
    lg.withdraw("b1", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 3_000_000 + LIMIT + 5_000_000 - LIMIT
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("b1", 1)


def test_limit_is_per_account(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Each account has its own limit."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 2_000_000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD", 2_000_000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("b1", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == LIMIT
    assert lg.balance("b1") == LIMIT


def test_set_day_resets_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    A new day has its own fresh limit."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 3_000_000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    lg.set_day(1)
    lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1_000_000
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1_000_000


def test_set_day_resets_limit_for_transfers(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Outgoing transfer limit is also per-day."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 3_000_000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    lg.transfer("a1", "b1", LIMIT, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 1, "k2")
    lg.set_day(5)
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", LIMIT, "k3") == "T2"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1_000_000
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 2_000_000


def test_set_day_each_day_tracked_separately(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Returning to a previous day keeps that day's usage."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 5_000_000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 700_000)
    lg.set_day(1)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 900_000)
    lg.set_day(0)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 300_001)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 300_000)
    lg.set_day(1)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 100_001)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 100_000)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 5_000_000 - 700_000 - 900_000 - 300_000 - 100_000


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R15 / R16

def test_frozen_blocks_withdraw(lg):
    """REQ: R15
    Withdrawals from frozen account raise AccountFrozen."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    lg.freeze("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountFrozen):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 100)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1000
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 1000, None)]


def test_frozen_blocks_outgoing_transfer(lg):
    """REQ: R15
    Outgoing transfers from frozen account raise AccountFrozen; no id consumed."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    lg.freeze("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountFrozen):
        lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 100, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1000
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 0
    lg.unfreeze("a1")
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 100, "k1") == "T1"


def test_frozen_accepts_deposits_and_incoming(lg):
    """REQ: R15
    Frozen accounts still accept deposits and incoming transfers."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    lg.freeze("b1")
    lg.deposit("b1", 50)
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 200, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 250
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 800
    assert lg.history("b1") == [("deposit", 50, None), ("transfer_in", 200, "a1")]


def test_unfreeze_restores(lg):
    """REQ: R16
    After unfreeze, withdrawals and transfers work again."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b1", "USD")
    lg.freeze("a1")
    lg.unfreeze("a1")
    lg.withdraw("a1", 100)
    assert lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 100, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 800
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 100


def test_unfreeze_not_frozen_is_noop(lg):
    """REQ: R16
    Unfreezing an unfrozen account leaves normal behaviour."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    lg.unfreeze("a1")
    lg.withdraw("a1", 10)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 990


def test_freeze_twice_then_unfreeze(lg):
    """REQ: R15, R16
    Double freeze then a single unfreeze restores behaviour."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    lg.freeze("a1")
    lg.freeze("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountFrozen):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    lg.unfreeze("a1")
    lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 999


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R17

def test_close_empty_account(lg):
    """REQ: R17
    Closing a zero-balance account succeeds; id cannot be reopened."""
    make(lg, "a1")
    lg.close_account("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "GBP")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a1")


def test_close_after_emptying(lg):
    """REQ: R17
    Account emptied to zero can be closed."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 100)
    lg.close_account("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a1")


def test_close_non_empty(lg):
    """REQ: R17
    Closing a non-zero account raises AccountNotEmpty; account remains."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotEmpty):
        lg.close_account("a1")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1
    lg.deposit("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 2
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 2


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R18

def test_balance_returns_int(lg):
    """REQ: R18
    balance returns current int balance."""
    make(lg, "a1", "GBP", 12345)
    b = lg.balance("a1")
    assert b == 12345
    assert type(b) is int


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R19

def test_history_empty(lg):
    """REQ: R19
    New account has empty history."""
    make(lg, "a1")
    assert lg.history("a1") == []


def test_history_chronological(lg):
    """REQ: R19
    History lists successful operations in order with correct tuples."""
    make(lg, "a1", "EUR")
    make(lg, "b1", "EUR")
    lg.deposit("a1", 1000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 100)
    lg.transfer("a1", "b1", 200, "k1")
    lg.transfer("b1", "a1", 50, "k2")
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 10_000)
    lg.deposit("b1", 7)
    assert lg.history("a1") == [
        ("deposit", 1000, None),
        ("withdrawal", 100, None),
        ("transfer_out", 200, "b1"),
        ("transfer_in", 50, "b1"),
    ]
    assert lg.history("b1") == [
        ("transfer_in", 200, "a1"),
        ("transfer_out", 50, "a1"),
        ("deposit", 7, None),
    ]


def test_history_returns_copy(lg):
    """REQ: R19
    Mutating the returned list does not affect the ledger."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 10)
    h = lg.history("a1")
    h.append(("deposit", 999, None))
    h.clear()
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 10, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R20

def test_total_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R20
    Total per currency sums open accounts, frozen included, closed excluded."""
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0
    make(lg, "u1", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "u2", "USD", 250)
    make(lg, "e1", "EUR", 70)
    make(lg, "g1", "GBP")
    make(lg, "u3", "USD")
    lg.freeze("u2")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 350
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 70
    assert lg.total_balance("GBP") == 0
    lg.close_account("u3")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 350
    lg.transfer("u1", "u2", 100, "k1")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 350
    lg.withdraw("u1", 0 + 0 or 0) if False else None
    lg.withdraw("u2", 50) if False else None
    lg.unfreeze("u2")
    lg.withdraw("u2", 50)
    lg.close_account("u1")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 300
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 70

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def funded(lg, acct, currency="USD", amount=0):
    lg.open_account(acct, currency)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acct, amount)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exceptions
def test_exception_hierarchy():
    """REQ: R2, R4, R5, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17
    All specific errors derive from LedgerError."""
    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1
@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currencies(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R18"""
    lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 0
    assert lg.history("acc1") == []
    assert lg.total_balance(cur) == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["usd", "JPY", "", "US", "USDX", None])
def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("acc1")
    # failure leaves state unchanged: id still usable
    lg.open_account("acc1", "USD")
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R2
def test_open_duplicate_account(lg):
    """REQ: R2"""
    lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a1", 500)
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "EUR")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 500
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R3
@pytest.mark.parametrize("aid", ["a", "A1b2C3", "x" * 20, "1234567890"])
def test_valid_account_ids(lg, aid):
    """REQ: R3"""
    lg.open_account(aid, "USD")
    assert lg.balance(aid) == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("aid", ["", "x" * 21, "ab-c", "ab c", "ab_c", "a.b", " a", "a!"])
def test_invalid_account_ids(lg, aid):
    """REQ: R3"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account(aid, "USD")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0


def test_invalid_account_id_non_string(lg):
    """REQ: R3"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account(123, "USD")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R4
def test_deposit_increases_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R4, R18"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 1
    lg.deposit("a", 250)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 251
    assert isinstance(lg.balance("a"), int)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amt", [0, -1, -100, 1.5, 10.0, "10", None])
def test_deposit_invalid_amount(lg, amt):
    """REQ: R4"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a", 100)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.deposit("a", amt)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 100
    assert lg.history("a") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R5
def test_deposit_unknown_account_does_not_create(lg):
    """REQ: R5"""
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("ghost", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("ghost")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0


def test_operations_on_unknown_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("ghost", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.history("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.freeze("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.unfreeze("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def funded(lg, acc, cur, amount):
    lg.open_account(acc, cur)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acc, amount)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currencies_zero_balance(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R18
    Opening with each supported currency yields balance 0."""
    lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 0
    assert isinstance(lg.balance("acc1"), int)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["usd", "JPY", "", "US", "USDX", None])
def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1
    Unsupported currency raises ValueError and creates nothing."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("acc1")
    # id is still free
    lg.open_account("acc1", "USD")
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R2

def test_open_duplicate_account(lg):
    """REQ: R2
    Opening an existing id raises AccountExists and keeps state."""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 500)
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "EUR")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 500
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 500
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R3

@pytest.mark.parametrize("acc", ["a", "A1b2C3", "1234567890", "a" * 20])
def test_valid_account_ids(lg, acc):
    """REQ: R3
    Non-empty alphanumeric ids up to 20 chars are accepted."""
    lg.open_account(acc, "USD")
    assert lg.balance(acc) == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("acc", ["", "a" * 21, "ab-c", "ab c", "a_b", "abc!", " abc"])
def test_invalid_account_ids(lg, acc):
    """REQ: R3
    Empty, too long or non-alphanumeric ids raise ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account(acc, "USD")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R4

def test_deposit_increases_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R4, R18
    Deposits add to the balance."""
    lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1
    lg.deposit("a1", 249)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 250


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -1, -100, 1.0, 1.5, "5", None])
def test_deposit_invalid_amount(lg, amount):
    """REQ: R4
    Non-int or non-positive deposit amounts raise InvalidAmount; state unchanged."""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.deposit("a1", amount)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R5

def test_operations_on_unknown_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5
    Every operation on a never-opened account raises AccountNotFound."""
    lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a1", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("ghost", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("ghost", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.history("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.freeze("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.unfreeze("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("a1", "ghost", 10, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("ghost", "a1", 10, "k2")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


def test_deposit_does_not_create_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5
    A deposit to an unknown account does not create it."""
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("newacc", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("newacc")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0
    lg.open_account("newacc", "USD")
    assert lg.balance("newacc") == 0


def test_operations_on_closed_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5, R17
    A closed account behaves as non-existent."""
    lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    lg.open_account("b1", "USD")
    lg.deposit("b1", 100)
    lg.close_account("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("a1", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.history("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("b1", "a1", 10, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("a1")
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 100


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R6, R7

def test_withdraw_decreases_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R6
    Withdrawals subtract from the balance."""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 300)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 700
    lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 699


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -5, 2.0, "10", None])
def test_withdraw_invalid_amount(lg, amount):
    """REQ: R6
    Withdrawal amount rules match deposits."""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.withdraw("a1", amount)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1000
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 1000, None)]


def test_withdraw_insufficient_funds(lg):
    """REQ: R7
    Withdrawing more than the balance fails and leaves state unchanged."""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 500)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 501)

)

    lg = Ledger()

    """REQ: R2, R5, R4, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17

    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def funded(lg, acct, currency="USD", amount=0):
    lg.open_account(acct, currency)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acct, amount)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exceptions
def test_exception_hierarchy():
    """REQ: R2, R4, R5, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17
    All specific errors derive from LedgerError."""
    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)
    assert issubclass(LedgerError, Exception)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1
@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currency_zero_balance(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R18"""

def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def funded(lg, acct, currency="USD", amount=0):
    lg.open_account(acct, currency)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acct, amount)
    return lg


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exceptions

def test_exception_hierarchy():
    """REQ: R1, R2, R4, R5, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17
    All specific exceptions derive from LedgerError."""
    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currency_zero_balance(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R18"""
    lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 0
    assert isinstance(lg.balance("acc1"), int)
    assert lg.history("acc1") == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["JPY", "usd", "", "US", "USDX", None])
def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):

    # id was not consumed by the failed open

def test_unfreeze_not_frozen_account(lg):

    lg.freeze("a")
    lg.close_account("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):

def test_history_full(lg):
    """REQ: R19"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.open_account("b", "USD")

def test_history_excludes_failed_frozen_and_limit(lg):

    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 100
    lg.withdraw("b", 40)

def test_total_balance_empty(lg):
    """REQ: R20"""
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def funded(lg, acct, currency, amount):
    lg.open_account(acct, currency)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acct, amount)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1
@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currency_zero_balance(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R18"""
    lg.open_account("a1", cur)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0
    assert isinstance(lg.balance("a1"), int)
    assert lg.history("a1") == []
    assert lg.total_balance(cur) == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["usd", "JPY", "", "US", "USDX", "Eur"])
def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account("a1", cur)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a1")
    # id was not consumed by the failed attempt
    lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R2
def test_open_duplicate_account(lg):
    """REQ: R2"""
    lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a1", 500)
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "EUR")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 500
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 0


def test_exceptions_are_ledger_errors():
    """REQ: R2, R5"""
    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R3
@pytest.mark.parametrize("acct", ["a", "A1b2C3", "1", "a" * 20, "Z9" * 10])
def test_valid_account_ids(lg, acct):
    """REQ: R3"""
    lg.open_account(acct, "USD")
    assert lg.balance(acct) == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("acct", ["", "a" * 21, "ab-c", "a b", "a_b", "abc!", " abc", "abc\n"])
def test_invalid_account_ids(lg, acct):
    """REQ: R3"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account(acct, "USD")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R4
def test_deposit_increases_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R4, R18"""
    lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a1", 1)
    lg.deposit("a1", 249)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 250


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amt", [0, -1, -100, 1.5, 10.0, "10", None])
def test_deposit_invalid_amount(lg, amt):
    """REQ: R4"""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.deposit("a1", amt)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R5
def test_operations_on_unknown_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5"""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("nope", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("nope", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.history("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.freeze("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.unfreeze("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("a1", "nope", 10, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("nope", "a1", 10, "k2")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


def test_deposit_does_not_create_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5"""
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("ghost", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("ghost")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0
    # id still available
    lg.open_account("ghost", "USD")
    assert lg.balance("ghost") == 0


def test_operations_on_closed_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5, R17"""
    lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    funded(lg, "b1", "USD", 100)
    lg.close_account("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("a1", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.history("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.freeze("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("b1", "a1", 10, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 100


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R6
def test_withdraw_decreases_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R6"""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 300)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 700
    lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 699


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amt", [0, -5, 2.5, 100.0, "100"])
def test_withdraw_invalid_amount(lg, amt):
    """REQ: R6"""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.withdraw("a1", amt)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1000
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 1000, None)]

def test_withdraw_insufficient_funds(lg):

    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):

    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 500, None)]


def test_withdraw_from_empty_account(lg):

    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):

def test_withdraw_exact_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R7"""
    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 500)

    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0


def test_failed_withdraw_does_not_consume_limit(lg):

    funded(lg, "a1", "USD", 500)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 600)
    lg.deposit("a1", LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("a1", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 500


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R8
def test_transfer_moves_money_and_ids_sequential(lg):
    """REQ: R8"""
    funded(lg, "a", "USD", 1000)
    lg.open_account("b", "USD")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 300, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 700
    assert lg.balance("b") == 300
    assert lg.transfer("b", "a", 100, "k2") == "T2"
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 800, "k3") == "T3"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 0
    assert lg.balance("b") == 1000


def test_failed_transfers_do_not_consume_ids(lg):
    """REQ: R8, R11"""

    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 10, "k1") == "T1"
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):

    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 0, "k3")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 10, "k4") == "T2"


def test_ids_are_per_ledger(lg):

    for x in (lg, other):

    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 1, "k") == "T1"

@pytest.mark.parametrize("amt", [0, -10, 1.5, "5"])
def test_transfer_invalid_amount(lg, amt):

def test_failed_transfer_key_reusable(lg):

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R12
def test_idempotent_replay(lg):

def test_daily_limit_per_account(lg):

def test_daily_limit_resets_per_day(lg):

def test_initial_day_is_zero(lg):
    """REQ: R14"""
    funded(lg, "a", "USD", 3 * LIMIT)

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def funded(lg, acct, currency, amount):
    lg.open_account(acct, currency)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acct, amount)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exceptions

def test_exception_hierarchy():
    """REQ: R2, R4, R5, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17
    All specific errors derive from LedgerError."""
    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)
        assert issubclass(exc, Exception)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currencies_zero_balance(lg, cur):

def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):

        lambda: lg.transfer("b", "a", 10, "k1"),

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def funded(lg, acct, currency="USD", amount=0):
    lg.open_account(acct, currency)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acct, amount)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exceptions

def test_exception_hierarchy():
    """REQ: R2, R5, R4, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17
    All specific errors derive from LedgerError."""
    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)
        assert issubclass(exc, Exception)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currencies_balance_zero(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R18"""
    lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 0
    assert type(lg.balance("acc1")) is int
    assert lg.total_balance(cur) == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["usd", "JPY", "", "US", "USDX", "Eur", None])
def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):

def test_open_duplicate_account(lg):

    lg.deposit("acc1", 500)

        lg.open_account("acc1", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("acc1", "EUR")
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 500
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 0
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 500

@pytest.mark.parametrize("acct", ["", "a-b", "a b", "abc_1", "x.y", "a" * 21, "abc!", " abc"])

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

def test_valid_account_ids(lg, acct):

def test_deposit_increases_balance(lg):

    lg.deposit("a", 2_499)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("amt", [0, -1, -100, 1.5, 10.0, "100", None])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R5

def test_operations_on_unknown_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):

    # id is still free

        lg.freeze("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.unfreeze("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("b", "a", 10, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("b") == 100

def test_withdraw_decreases_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R6"""

def test_withdraw_exact_full_balance(lg):

def test_transfer_moves_money_and_ids_sequential(lg):
    """REQ: R8"""

    lg.open_account("b", "USD")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 300, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 700
    assert lg.balance("b") == 300

def test_failed_transfers_do_not_consume_ids(lg):

def test_failed_transfer_key_can_be_reused(lg):

    assert lg.balance("a") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R17

def test_close_empty_account(lg):
    """REQ: R17"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.close_account("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a")


def test_close_after_draining(lg):
    """REQ: R17"""
    funded(lg, "a", amount=100)
    lg.withdraw("a", 100)
    lg.close_account("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a")


def test_close_non_empty_account(lg):
    """REQ: R17"""
    funded(lg, "a", amount=1)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotEmpty):
        lg.close_account("a")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 1
    lg.deposit("a", 9)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 10
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 10


def test_closed_id_cannot_be_reopened(lg):
    """REQ: R17, R2"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.close_account("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a", "EUR")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a")


def test_close_frozen_empty_account(lg):
    """REQ: R17, R15"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.freeze("a")
    lg.close_account("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R18

def test_balance_returns_int(lg):
    """REQ: R18"""
    funded(lg, "a", amount=12_345)
    b = lg.balance("a")
    assert b == 12_345
    assert type(b) is int


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R19

def test_history_new_account_empty(lg):
    """REQ: R19"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    assert lg.history("a") == []


def test_history_chronological(lg):
    """REQ: R19"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.open_account("b", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a", 1_000)
    lg.withdraw("a", 100)
    lg.transfer("a", "b", 300, "k1")
    lg.transfer("b", "a", 50, "k2")
    lg.deposit("b", 7)
    assert lg.history("a") == [
        ("deposit", 1_000, None),
        ("withdrawal", 100, None),
        ("transfer_out", 300, "b"),
        ("transfer_in", 50, "b"),
    ]
    assert lg.history("b") == [
        ("transfer_in", 300, "a"),
        ("transfer_out", 50, "a"),
        ("deposit", 7, None),
    ]


def test_history_excludes_failed_operations(lg):
    """REQ: R19"""
    funded(lg, "a", amount=100)
    lg.open_account("b", "USD")
    lg.open_account("e", "EUR")
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a", 200)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.deposit("a", 0)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 200, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(CurrencyMismatch):
        lg.transfer("a", "e", 10, "k2")
    assert lg.history("a") == [("deposit", 100, None)]
    assert lg.history("b") == []
    assert lg.history("e") == []


def test_history_returned_list_not_aliased(lg):
    """REQ: R19"""
    funded(lg, "a", amount=100)
    h = lg.history("a")
    h.append(("deposit", 999, None))
    h.clear()
    assert lg.history("a") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R20

def test_total_balance_by_currency(lg):
    """REQ: R20"""
    funded(lg, "u1", "USD", 100)
    funded(lg, "u2", "USD", 250)
    funded(lg, "e1", "EUR", 70)
    lg.open_account("g1", "GBP")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 350
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 70
    assert lg.total_balance("GBP") == 0


def test_total_balance_empty_ledger(lg):
    """REQ: R20"""
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 0
    assert lg.total_balance("GBP") == 0


def test_total_balance_includes_frozen(lg):
    """REQ: R20, R15"""
    funded(lg, "a", "USD", 100)
    funded(lg, "b", "USD", 200)
    lg.freeze("a")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 300


def test_total_balance_after_movements_and_close(lg):
    """REQ: R20, R17"""
    funded(lg, "a", "USD", 1_000)
    lg.open_account("b", "USD")
    lg.open_account("c", "USD")
    lg.transfer("a", "b", 400, "k1")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 1_000
    lg.withdraw("b", 150)
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 850
    lg.close_account("c")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 850

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def make(lg, acct, cur="USD", amount=0):
    lg.open_account(acct, cur)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acct, amount)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exceptions
def test_exception_hierarchy():
    """REQ: R2, R4, R5, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17
    All ledger-specific exceptions derive from LedgerError."""
    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)
    assert issubclass(LedgerError, Exception)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1
@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currency_zero_balance(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R18
    Opening an account with a supported currency gives balance 0."""
    lg.open_account("a1", cur)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0
    assert lg.history("a1") == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["JPY", "usd", "", "US D", "EURO"])
def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R5
    Unsupported currency raises ValueError and creates nothing."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account("a1", cur)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a1")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R2
def test_open_duplicate_account(lg):
    """REQ: R2
    Opening an existing id raises AccountExists; state unchanged."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 500)
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a1", "EUR")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 500
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 0
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 500


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R3
@pytest.mark.parametrize("acct", ["a", "A1b2C3", "x" * 20, "12345678901234567890"])
def test_valid_account_ids(lg, acct):
    """REQ: R3
    Non-empty alphanumeric ids of length 1..20 are accepted."""
    lg.open_account(acct, "USD")
    assert lg.balance(acct) == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("acct", ["", "x" * 21, "ab-c", "ab c", "a_b", "a.b", "a!"])
def test_invalid_account_ids(lg, acct):
    """REQ: R3
    Empty, too long, or non-alphanumeric ids raise ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account(acct, "USD")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R4
def test_deposit_increases_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R4, R18
    Deposits add to the balance."""
    make(lg, "a1")
    lg.deposit("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 1
    lg.deposit("a1", 250)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 251
    assert isinstance(lg.balance("a1"), int)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -1, -100, 1.0, 10.5, "5", None])
def test_deposit_invalid_amount(lg, amount):
    """REQ: R4
    Non-int or non-positive deposits raise InvalidAmount; state unchanged."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.deposit("a1", amount)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R5
def test_operations_on_unknown_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5
    Every operation on a never-opened account raises AccountNotFound."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("nope", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("nope", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.history("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.freeze("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.unfreeze("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("nope")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("a1", "nope", 10, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("nope", "a1", 10, "k2")
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


def test_deposit_does_not_create_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5
    A failed deposit to an unknown id does not create it."""
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("ghost", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("ghost")
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 0


def test_operations_on_closed_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5, R17
    Operations on a closed account raise AccountNotFound."""
    make(lg, "a1")
    make(lg, "b1", "USD", 100)
    lg.close_account("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("a1", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.history("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.freeze("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("a1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("b1", "a1", 10, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("b1") == 100


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R6 / R7
def test_withdraw_decreases_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R6
    Withdrawals reduce the balance."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 1000)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 999
    lg.withdraw("a1", 499)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 500


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -5, 2.0, "3", None])
def test_withdraw_invalid_amount(lg, amount):
    """REQ: R6
    Withdrawal amounts follow the R4 rules."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 100)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.withdraw("a1", amount)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 100
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


def test_withdraw_full_balance_allowed(lg):
    """REQ: R7
    Withdrawing exactly the full balance leaves zero."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 750)
    lg.withdraw("a1", 750)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 0


def test_withdraw_insufficient(lg):
    """REQ: R7
    Overdrawing raises InsufficientFunds and leaves balance unchanged."""
    make(lg, "a1", "USD", 750)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a1", 751)
    assert lg.balance("a1") == 750
    assert lg.history("a1") == [("deposit", 750, None)]
    make(lg, "z1")
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("z1", 1)
    assert lg.balance("z1") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R8
def test_transfer_moves_money_and_ids_sequential(lg):
    """REQ: R8
    Transfers move money and return T1, T2, ... in order."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b", "USD", 0)
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 300, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 700
    assert lg.balance("b") == 300
    assert lg.transfer("b", "a", 100, "k2") == "T2"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 800
    assert lg.balance("b") == 200


def test_transfer_full_balance(lg):
    """REQ: R8, R11
    Transferring exactly the full balance is allowed."""
    make(lg, "a", "EUR", 500)
    make(lg, "b", "EUR")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 500, "k") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 0
    assert lg.balance("b") == 500


def test_failed_transfers_do_not_consume_ids(lg):
    """REQ: R8, R11
    Only successful transfers consume transfer ids."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 101, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 0, "k2")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 50, "k3") == "T1"
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 50, "k4") == "T2"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -1, 1.5, "10"])
def test_transfer_invalid_amount(lg, amount):
    """REQ: R8, R4
    Transfer amounts must be positive ints."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", amount, "k")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 100
    assert lg.balance("b") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R9
def test_transfer_currency_mismatch(lg):
    """REQ: R9
    Cross-currency transfers raise CurrencyMismatch; no change."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b", "EUR")
    make(lg, "c", "GBP")
    with pytest.raises(CurrencyMismatch):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 10, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(CurrencyMismatch):
        lg.transfer("a", "c", 10, "k2")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 100
    assert lg.balance("b") == 0
    assert lg.balance("c") == 0
    assert lg.history("b") == []
    # failed transfer consumed no id
    make(lg, "d", "USD")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "d", 10, "k3") == "T1"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R10
def test_transfer_same_account(lg):
    """REQ: R10
    Self-transfer raises ValueError; balance unchanged."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 100)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.transfer("a", "a", 10, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 100
    assert lg.history("a") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R11
def test_transfer_insufficient(lg):
    """REQ: R11
    Transfer exceeding source balance changes neither balance."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 100)
    make(lg, "b", "USD", 50)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 101, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 100
    assert lg.balance("b") == 50
    assert lg.history("a") == [("deposit", 100, None)]
    assert lg.history("b") == [("deposit", 50, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R12
def test_idempotent_retry(lg):
    """REQ: R12
    Repeating a transfer with the same key and params returns same id, no money moves."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    t = lg.transfer("a", "b", 200, "key")
    assert t == "T1"
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 200, "key") == "T1"
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 200, "key") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 800
    assert lg.balance("b") == 200
    assert lg.history("a") == [("deposit", 1000, None), ("transfer_out", 200, "b")]
    assert lg.history("b") == [("transfer_in", 200, "a")]
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 200, "key2") == "T2"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 600


def test_idempotent_retry_does_not_count_toward_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R12, R14
    An idempotent replay moves no money and uses no limit."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 2 * LIMIT)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    lg.transfer("a", "b", LIMIT, "k")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", LIMIT, "k") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a") == LIMIT
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", 1)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R13
def test_idempotency_conflict(lg):
    """REQ: R13
    Reusing a key with different params raises IdempotencyConflict."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    make(lg, "c", "USD")
    lg.transfer("a", "b", 100, "key")
    with pytest.raises(IdempotencyConflict):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 101, "key")
    with pytest.raises(IdempotencyConflict):
        lg.transfer("a", "c", 100, "key")
    with pytest.raises(IdempotencyConflict):
        lg.transfer("b", "a", 100, "key")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 900
    assert lg.balance("b") == 100
    assert lg.balance("c") == 0
    assert lg.transfer("a", "c", 100, "other") == "T2"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R14
def test_daily_limit_withdraw_exact(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Withdrawing exactly the daily limit is allowed; one more cent is not."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 3 * LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 2 * LIMIT
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 2 * LIMIT


def test_daily_limit_single_over(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    A single operation over the limit raises LimitExceeded."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 3 * LIMIT)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT + 1)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", LIMIT + 1, "k")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 3 * LIMIT
    assert lg.balance("b") == 0
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", LIMIT, "k2") == "T1"


def test_daily_limit_combines_withdrawals_and_transfers(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Withdrawals and outgoing transfers share the daily limit."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 3 * LIMIT)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    lg.withdraw("a", 400_000)
    lg.transfer("a", "b", 500_000, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 100_001, "k2")
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", 100_001)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 3 * LIMIT - 900_000
    assert lg.balance("b") == 500_000
    lg.withdraw("a", 100_000)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 3 * LIMIT - LIMIT


def test_failed_limit_operation_does_not_consume_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    A rejected operation does not use up the limit."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 3 * LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("a", 600_000)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", 500_000)
    lg.withdraw("a", 400_000)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 2 * LIMIT


def test_insufficient_funds_does_not_consume_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R14, R7
    Failed withdrawal for insufficient funds uses no limit."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 500_000)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):
        lg.withdraw("a", 900_000)
    lg.deposit("a", 2 * LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 2 * LIMIT + 500_000 - LIMIT


def test_incoming_and_deposits_not_counted(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Deposits and incoming transfers do not count toward the limit."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 5 * LIMIT)
    make(lg, "b", "USD", 5 * LIMIT)
    lg.transfer("b", "a", LIMIT, "k1")
    lg.deposit("a", 2 * LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 5 * LIMIT + LIMIT + 2 * LIMIT - LIMIT


def test_limit_is_per_account(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Each account has its own daily limit."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 2 * LIMIT)
    make(lg, "b", "USD", 2 * LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("b", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a") == LIMIT
    assert lg.balance("b") == LIMIT


def test_set_day_resets_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    Each day has its own limit; returning to a day keeps its usage."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 5 * LIMIT)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", 1)
    lg.set_day(1)
    lg.withdraw("a", 600_000)
    lg.transfer("a", "b", 400_000, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", 1)
    lg.set_day(2)
    lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    lg.set_day(0)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", 1)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 5 * LIMIT - 3 * LIMIT
    assert lg.balance("b") == 400_000


def test_initial_day_is_zero(lg):
    """REQ: R14
    The initial day is 0: usage before set_day(0) persists after it."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 2 * LIMIT)
    lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    lg.set_day(0)
    with pytest.raises(LimitExceeded):
        lg.withdraw("a", 1)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R15
def test_frozen_blocks_outgoing(lg):
    """REQ: R15
    Frozen account cannot withdraw or send transfers."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b", "USD", 1000)
    lg.freeze("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountFrozen):
        lg.withdraw("a", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountFrozen):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 100, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 1000
    assert lg.balance("b") == 1000
    assert lg.history("a") == [("deposit", 1000, None)]


def test_frozen_accepts_incoming(lg):
    """REQ: R15
    Frozen account still accepts deposits and incoming transfers."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 1000)
    make(lg, "b", "USD", 1000)
    lg.freeze("a")
    lg.deposit("a", 50)
    assert lg.transfer("b", "a", 200, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 1250
    assert lg.balance("b") == 800


def test_frozen_failed_transfer_consumes_no_limit(lg):
    """REQ: R15, R16, R14
    Rejected transfer from frozen account uses no limit."""
    make(lg, "a", "USD", 3 * LIMIT)
    make(lg, "b", "USD")
    lg.freeze("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountFrozen):
        lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    lg.unfreeze("a")
    lg.withdraw("a", LIMIT)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 2 * LIMIT


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R16
def test_unfreeze_restores(lg):

)

LIMIT = 1_000_000


@pytest.fixture

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,

    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,

)

def led():
    return Ledger()


def make(currency_map, deposits=None):
    lg = Ledger()

        lg.open_account(acc, cur)
    for acc, amt in (deposits or {}).items():
        lg.deposit(acc, amt)

                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)


@pytest.fixture

def test_exception_hierarchy():
    """REQ: R2, R4, R5, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17

    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)
        assert issubclass(exc, Exception)

    assert led.balance("B") == 300
    assert led.history("A") == [("deposit", 1000, None), ("transfer_out", 300, "B")]
    assert led.history("B") == [("transfer_in", 300, "A")]
    assert led.transfer("A", "B", 300, "k2") == "T2"
    assert led.balance("A") == 400


def test_idempotent_repeat_does_not_count_limit(led):
    """REQ: R12, R14"""
    two_usd(led, 2_000_000, 0)
    led.transfer("A", "B", 600_000, "k1")
    led.transfer("A", "B", 600_000, "k1")
    led.withdraw("A", 400_000)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R13
@pytest.mark.parametrize("args", [("A", "B", 200), ("B", "A", 100), ("A", "C", 100)])
def test_idempotency_conflict(led, args):

    two_usd(led, 1000, 1000)
    led.open_account("C", "USD")
    led.transfer("A", "B", 100, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(IdempotencyConflict):
        led.transfer(*args, "k1")
    assert led.balance("A") == 900
    assert led.balance("B") == 1100
    assert led.balance("C") == 0
    assert led.transfer("A", "B", 1, "k2") == "T2"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R14
def test_daily_limit_withdraw_exact_then_exceed(led):

def test_daily_limit_single_over(led):

def test_daily_limit_combined_transfer_and_withdraw(led):

    assert led.balance("B") == 500_000
    led.transfer("A", "B", 100_000, "k2")

def test_daily_limit_incoming_and_deposits_not_counted(led):

def test_daily_limit_resets_per_day(led):

def test_daily_limit_per_account(led):

def test_close_non_zero_raises(led):

def test_closed_id_cannot_be_reopened(led):
    """REQ: R17, R2"""

    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):

def test_balance_returns_int(led):

def test_history_chronological(led):
    """REQ: R19"""

def test_history_returns_copy(led):

def test_total_balance_per_currency(led):
    """REQ: R20"""
    assert led.total_balance("USD") == 0
    led.open_account("U1", "USD")

def test_total_balance_includes_frozen(led):
    """REQ: R20, R15"""

def test_total_balance_after_transfer_and_close(led):
    """REQ: R20, R17"""

import pytest

from ledger import (
    Ledger,
    LedgerError,
    AccountExists,
    AccountNotFound,
    InvalidAmount,
    InsufficientFunds,
    CurrencyMismatch,
    IdempotencyConflict,
    LimitExceeded,
    AccountFrozen,
    AccountNotEmpty,
)


@pytest.fixture
def lg():
    return Ledger()


def funded(lg, acct, currency, amount):
    lg.open_account(acct, currency)
    if amount:
        lg.deposit(acct, amount)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- hierarchy

def test_exception_hierarchy():
    """REQ: R2, R4, R5, R7, R9, R13, R14, R15, R17
    All domain exceptions derive from LedgerError."""
    for exc in (AccountExists, AccountNotFound, InvalidAmount, InsufficientFunds,
                CurrencyMismatch, IdempotencyConflict, LimitExceeded,
                AccountFrozen, AccountNotEmpty):
        assert issubclass(exc, LedgerError)
    assert issubclass(LedgerError, Exception)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R1

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"])
def test_open_account_supported_currencies_balance_zero(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1, R18"""
    lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 0
    assert lg.history("acc1") == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cur", ["JPY", "usd", "", "US", "USDX", "Eur"])
def test_open_account_unsupported_currency(lg, cur):
    """REQ: R1"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lg.open_account("acc1", cur)
    # state unchanged: account not created and id still free
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("acc1")
    lg.open_account("acc1", "USD")
    assert lg.balance("acc1") == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R2

def test_open_duplicate_account(lg):
    """REQ: R2"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a", 500)
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(AccountExists):
        lg.open_account("a", "EUR")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 500
    assert lg.total_balance("EUR") == 0
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 500


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R3

@pytest.mark.parametrize("acct_id", ["", "a-b", "a b", " a", "abc!", "x" * 21, "a_b", "ab.c"])
def test_invalid_account_ids(lg, acct_id):
    """REQ: R3"""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

def test_valid_account_ids(lg, acct_id):

def test_deposit_increases_balance(lg):

@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -1, -100, 1.5, 10.0, "10", None])
def test_deposit_invalid_amount(lg, amount):
    """REQ: R4"""

    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.deposit("a", amount)
    assert lg.balance("a") == 100
    assert lg.history("a") == [("deposit", 100, None)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- R5

def test_operations_on_unknown_account(lg):
    """REQ: R5"""
    lg.open_account("a", "USD")
    lg.deposit("a", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("ghost", 100)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.balance("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("ghost", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):

    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):

    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.unfreeze("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("ghost")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("a", "ghost", 10, "k1")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("ghost", "a", 10, "k2")
    assert lg.balance("a") == 100
    assert lg.total_balance("USD") == 100


def test_deposit_does_not_create_account(lg):

def test_operations_on_closed_account(lg):

    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.deposit("a", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.withdraw("a", 10)
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.history("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.freeze("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.unfreeze("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.close_account("a")
    with pytest.raises(AccountNotFound):
        lg.transfer("b", "a", 10, "k1")
    assert lg.balance("b") == 100

    lg.withdraw("a", 1)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -5, 2.5, 100.0, "50", None])

def test_withdraw_insufficient_funds(lg):

def test_withdraw_from_empty_account(lg):

def test_withdraw_full_balance(lg):

def test_transfer_moves_money_and_ids_sequential(lg):
    """REQ: R8"""
    funded(lg, "a", "USD", 1000)
    lg.open_account("b", "USD")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 100, "k1") == "T1"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 900
    assert lg.balance("b") == 100
    assert lg.transfer("b", "a", 40, "k2") == "T2"
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 900, "k3") == "T3"
    assert lg.balance("a") == 0
    assert lg.balance("b") == 1000


def test_failed_transfers_do_not_consume_ids(lg):
    """REQ: R8, R11"""

    lg.open_account("b", "USD")
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):

    with pytest.raises(InvalidAmount):
        lg.transfer("a", "b", 0, "k2")
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 50, "k3") == "T1"


def test_failed_transfer_does_not_register_idempotency_key(lg):
    """REQ: R8, R11, R13"""

    with pytest.raises(InsufficientFunds):

    # key is still unused, so a different transfer with it is fine
    assert lg.transfer("a", "b", 30, "k") == "T1"

@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -1, 1.5, "10"])
def test_transfer_invalid_amount(lg, amount):

def test_idempotent_repeat_returns_original_id_later(lg):

def test_daily_limit_exact_withdrawal(lg):

def test_daily_limit_combines_withdrawals_and_transfers(lg):
